# GUI Interface Description

## System Header Bar
- **Left Side**: "Activities" text with a circular icon
- **Center**: "Settings" text
- **Right Side**: 
  - Date and time: "Oct 23 00:59"
  - Notification bell icon
  - System status icons (network, sound, power)

## Desktop Environment
- **Background**: Gradient wallpaper transitioning from dark purple to red-orange
- **Desktop Icons**: 
  - "Home" folder icon at bottom right corner
  - "Home" label beneath the icon

## Left Sidebar (Dock)
- **Top to Bottom**:
  - Activities icon
  - Google Chrome icon
  - Thunderbird email client icon
  - Visual Studio Code icon
  - VLC media player icon
  - LibreOffice Writer icon
  - LibreOffice Calc icon
  - LibreOffice Impress icon
  - GIMP icon
  - Ubuntu Software icon
  - Help icon (question mark)
  - Settings icon (gear)
  - Trash icon
  - Grid icon (app launcher)

## File Manager Window
- **Title Bar**: "Home" with house icon
- **Navigation Bar**:
  - Back arrow
  - Forward arrow
  - Home icon
- **Left Panel**:
  - "Recent" with clock icon
  - "Starred" with star icon
  - "Home" with house icon (selected)
  - "Desktop" with folder icon
  - "Documents" with folder icon
  - "Downloads" with down arrow icon
  - "Music" with music note icon
  - "Pictures" with image icon
  - "Videos" with video camera icon
  - "Trash" with trash can icon
  - "Other Locations" with plus icon
- **Right Panel**:
  - Folder icons:
    - "Desktop"
    - "Documents"
    - "server"
    - "snap"
    - ".bashrc"
    - ".cache"
    - ".mozilla"
    - ".pki"
    - ".var"
    - ".viminfo"

## Settings Window
- **Title Bar**: "Settings" with search icon and menu icon
- **Window Controls**: Minimize, maximize, close buttons on right
- **Left Sidebar (Settings Categories)**:
  - "Network" with globe icon
  - "Bluetooth" with Bluetooth icon
  - "Background" with monitor icon
  - "Appearance" with paintbrush icon
  - "Notifications" with bell icon
  - "Search" with magnifying glass icon
  - "Multitasking" with window icon
  - "Applications" with grid icon (with right arrow)
  - "Privacy" with lock icon (with right arrow)
  - "Online Accounts" with cloud icon
  - "Sharing" with share icon
  - "Sound" with musical note icon
  - "Power" with lightning bolt icon (selected, highlighted in orange)
  - "Displays" with monitor icon
  - "Mouse & Touchpad" with mouse icon
  - "Keyboard" with keyboard icon
  - "Printers" with printer icon
- **Right Panel (Power Settings)**:
  - **Power Mode Section**:
    - Title: "Power Mode"
    - Description: "Affects system performance and power usage."
    - "Balanced" option (selected, with orange dot) - "Standard performance and power usage."
    - "Power Saver" option (unselected) - "Reduced performance and power usage."
  - **Power Saving Options Section**:
    - Title: "Power Saving Options"
    - "Screen Blank" - "Turns the screen off after a period of inactivity." with dropdown set to "Never"
    - "Automatic Suspend" - "Pauses the computer after a period of inactivity." with setting set to "Off"
